names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 4 aprilie, «Sfântul Cuvios Gheorghe de la Maleon».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 4 Απριλίου, «Όσιος Γεώργιος ο εν Μαλεώ», with the rank word and the place left off.

Read out of the title on the name link behind his line for 4 апреля ст. ст., name page 496, «Георгий Пелопонесский, Малеин, прп.», with the rank abbreviation left off and the first of the two toponymics left in the life: «Малеин» is the one the day’s own line repeats, «иже в Малеи», and the one the display name follows. The bare «Георгий» is held by three folders as their ru form; no folder holds this form or «Георгий Пелопонесский».

death.note: Two books disagree by three centuries and the range is widened to hold both rather than choose. days.pravoslavie.ru closes his line for 4 апреля ст. ст. with «(V-VI)» and its life opens «Преподобный Георгий жил в V-VI вв.»; the ninth century this folder held before is the Romanian and Greek reading. Neither book gives him a year, a reign or an abbot, and nothing here is averaged.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 4 апреля ст. ст. — «Прп. Георгия , иже в Малеи (V-VI).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 4 aprilie — «Sfântul Cuvios Gheorghe de la Maleon»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Απριλίου — «Όσιος Γεώργιος ο εν Μαλεώ»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It gives him no year and no century at all, so the ninth century this folder holds from doxologia.ro is left as it stands; the page spells the mountain Μαλαιό in its prose and Μαλεώ in the day's line. It prints two apolytikia and a kontakion.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

hymns.text: Cu curgerile lacrimilor tale ai lucrat pustiul cel neroditor şi cu suspinurile cele dintru adânc ai făcut ostenelile tale însutit roditoare; şi te-ai făcut luminător lumii, strălucind cu minunile, Gheorghe, părintele nostru. Roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu ca să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Gheorghe din Maleon, Glasul 8

english.text: With the streams of thy tears thou didst till the barren desert, and with sighs from the depths thou didst make thy labours bear fruit a hundredfold; and thou becamest a light to the world, shining with miracles, O George our father. Pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Ὡς θεῖον Γεώργιον, δικαιοσύνης καρπούς, πλουσίως ἐξήνεγκας, δι’ ἐνάρετου ζωῆς, Γεώργιε Ὅσιε, σὺ γὰρ καθάπερ φοῖνιξ, ἐν ἀσκήσει βλαστήσας, τρέφεις τὴ δωρεά σου, τὴν Χριστοῦ Ἐκκλησίαν ὅθεν ἀεὶ εὐχαρίστως, τιμᾷ τὴν μνήμη σου.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ', Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε, on the page of Όσιος Γεώργιος ο εν Μαλεώ. It is his own and plays his name against γεωργός, the husbandman.

english.text: As a divine husbandman thou didst richly bring forth the fruits of righteousness by a life of virtue, O venerable George; for having sprung up in asceticism like a palm tree, thou dost feed the Church of Christ with thy gift; whence she ever honours thy memory with thanksgiving.

hymns.text: Ταῖς τῶν δακρύων σου ῥοαῖς, τῆς ἐρήμου τό ἄγονον ἐγεώργησας· καί τοῖς ἐκ βάθους στεναγμοῖς, εἰς ἑκατόν τούς πόνους ἐκαρποφόρησας· καί γέγονας φωστήρ τῇ οἰκουμένῃ, λάμπων τοῖς θαύμασιν, Γεώργιε Πατήρ ἡμῶν ὅσιε, πρέσβευε Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ, σωθῆναι τάς ψυχάς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr — Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, on the page of Όσιος Γεώργιος ο εν Μαλεώ. This is the common apolytikion of a venerable ascetic, with his name set into it; the page prints it under his name, so it is copied whole as the page has it.

english.text: With the streams of thy tears thou didst till the barrenness of the desert, and with thy sighs from the depths thou didst bring thy labours to fruit a hundredfold; and thou becamest a luminary to the world, shining with wonders, O George our venerable father. Intercede with Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Γεωργός πανάριστος, τῆς ἐγκρατείας ἐγένου, τὸ δοθέν σοι τάλαντον, ἀσκητικῶς ἐπαυξήσας· ὅθεν σοι, ἡ ἐπουράνιος κληρουχία, δίδοται, ἀνθ᾽ὧν διήνυσας Πάτερ πόνων· ὁ Χριστός γάρ σε δοξάζει, ὃν ἵλεών μοι δίδου Γεώργιε.

source.text: saint.gr — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος γ', Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον, on the page of Όσιος Γεώργιος ο εν Μαλεώ. It names him and turns on the same play on his name.

english.text: Thou becamest a most excellent husbandman of abstinence, increasing by ascetic labour the talent that was given thee; whence the inheritance of heaven is given thee in return for the labours thou didst accomplish, O Father; for Christ glorifies thee, and do thou make him merciful to me, O George.
